fact: Loi N° 027/2020 of 24 December 2020, promulgated after Constitutional Court review, sets up a 14-character Personal Identification Number (NIP) attributed after capture of fingerprints and facial photograph and run by the Centre National de l'Etat Civil.
title: Loi N° 027/2020 du 24/12/2020 relative au numéro d'identification personnel
publisher: Journal Officiel de la République Gabonaise
